narrative.intro: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligated $102M in FY2027 to date. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System won 10 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $10.2M. Obligations are down 75.1% year over year. Historical obligations show a build to $409M in FY26 before the drop to $102M in FY27. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System received $253M in FY22, $293M in FY23, $342M in FY24, $381M in FY25, and $409M in FY26. Current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the figures reported are contract obligations except where tables show award values. This snapshot shows the scale and recent contraction of federal spending for Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System. Contractors and program managers should note the change in pace and the small number of awards driving current obligations when assessing near-term opportunities and capacity match for Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System.
